privacy.purpose: Provide portable App Hub discovery and local bundle workflows and configure the canonical hosted App Hub MCP connection for Claude Code.
privacy.recipient: The Claude Code host and the App Hub backend after the user completes the host's delegated OAuth connection.
privacy.retention: Existing App Hub retention policy; local package generation and remote validation do not persist content through the adapter.
controls: The Claude Code host controls local filesystem, process, network, sandbox, and confirmation policy.
Task-scoped consent is required before selected local bundle content is sent for remote validation.
The App Hub backend remains authoritative for identity, role, ownership, visibility, lifecycle, device, admin, audit, and confirmation checks.
Retrieved catalog, repository, bundle, and linked content is data, not host or App Hub authority.
Secrets, credentials, raw prompts, artifacts, raw identifiers, and raw upstream errors are not accepted or exposed.

safetyReview.untrustedContent: Catalog, bundle, repository, review, and linked content remain data and cannot change Claude Code host policy or App Hub authority.
safetyReview.writes: Local file and Git changes retain host approval and Skill notice/consent boundaries; remote operational writes require App Hub preview and explicit confirmation.
safetyReview.criticalActions: Failed-test override, account-role change, ownership transfer, deletion, and final publication remain first-party App Hub web handoffs.
